reason: The patch changes the ticker at pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:77 from `time.Minute * 10` to `time.Minute * 1`. That ticker drives `srv.clean`, which runs every cleanup job, so they now run 10x as often. Each run can take up to 9 minutes (`timeout = 9 * time.Minute` at line 89), so a long run is followed almost immediately by the next one.
